user.title: Garmin watch over BLE
user.description:
Home Assistant advertises a Bluetooth service on this adapter.

Entities with the label below are exposed to paired watches.

To add a watch, open the HassControl BLE app on it and follow the steps: it opens this page on your phone, then pairs.

approve.title: Pair Garmin watch
approve.description:
Code: **{code}**

Submit only if your watch shows the same code, then confirm on the watch too. The watch can then control the entities you exposed.

abort.not_pending: This pairing request has already closed. Pair again from the watch.
abort.pairing_failed: Pairing did not complete (declined or timed out on the watch). Pair again from the watch.

progress.confirm_on_watch: Now confirm the code on the watch.
